title: Configure netboot.xyz
description: Configure the netboot.xyz PXE boot server

host.description: Host name of the web app (menu editor). Empty disables the web route.

admin_user.description: Web app login name (HTTP basic auth)

admin_password.description: New web app password; empty keeps the stored one

ip_allowlist.description: Client networks (CIDR) allowed to reach the web app; empty allows all

pxe_server_ip.description: Node IPv4 address clients load the boot files from (TFTP)

proxy_dhcp.description: Answer PXE clients with proxyDHCP, leaving the LAN DHCP server unchanged

uefi_boot_mode.description: UEFI boot file: standard netboot.xyz iPXE or the signed Secure Boot chain
